132 /**
133 * @brief Synchronizes canvas shape default outline color with the currently active inking pen preset.
134 *
135 * By default, newly created vector shapes automatically inherit the outline color and opacity of the
136 * last used/active inking pen tool while keeping infill transparent (ShapeFillType::None), providing
137 * seamless continuity between freehand inking and geometric diagramming.
138 *
139 * @param canvas Reference to CanvasEngine whose shapeCreation defaults will be updated.
140 */
141 void SyncShapePenColor(CanvasEngine& canvas) {
142 auto* activePreset = presetManager.GetActivePreset();
143 if (activePreset) {
144 uint8_t r = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(activePreset->color.x * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f));
145 uint8_t g = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(activePreset->color.y * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f));
146 uint8_t b = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(activePreset->color.z * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f));
147 // Shape outline is always 100% opaque: pen opacity/translucency must NOT bleed into shape borders.
148 // Alpha is forced to 255 regardless of the active pen's opacity setting.
149 canvas.shapeCreation.defaultOutlineColor = BLRgba32(r, g, b, 0xFF);
150 }
151 canvas.shapeCreation.defaultFillType = Folio::ShapeFillType::None;
152 }

154 /**
155 * @brief Renders the compact 4-column vector shape selection grid palette.
156 *
157 * Visual and Layout Organization:
158 * - Section "Lines": Linear connectors (Line, Line Arrow) with custom 2-point endpoint drag handles.
159 * - Section "Basic Shapes": 4-column grid of 2D geometric vector primitives:
160 * Row 1: Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Circle (center-outward), Ellipse (2-step major/minor axis)
161 * Row 2: Triangle (Isosceles), Right Triangle (90 deg), Regular Polygon (3-32 sides), Star (5-point)
162 * - Interactive cells: 42x42 square buttons with embedded anti-aliased Blend2D/ImGui vector icons,
163 * hover elevation highlights, active selection indicators, and descriptive tooltips.
164 *
165 * Working Process:
166 * - Creation Mode (Insert / Draw tabs): Selecting a shape synchronizes active pen color, initializes
167 * shape type defaults, and transitions input state machine to InteractionState::DrawingShape.
168 * - Switcher Mode (Shape Format tab): Selecting converts an existing selected shape's geometry,
169 * recalculating boundary segments and re-baking the static canvas layer without raster distortion.
170 *
171 * @param canvas Reference to CanvasEngine.
172 * @param inputSM Reference to InputStateMachine for updating device interaction mode.
173 * @param theme ThemeManager reference for colors and styling.
174 * @param selectedShape Currently selected shape object (if in Shape Format switcher mode).
175 * @param isSwitcher If true, switching changes existing selected shape geometry; if false, enters shape drawing mode.
176 */
177 /**
178 * @brief Helper to get the short display name for a given ShapeType.
179 */
180 static const char* GetShapeTypeName(Folio::ShapeType type) {
181 switch (type) {
182 case Folio::ShapeType::Rectangle: return "Rectangle";
183 case Folio::ShapeType::RoundedRectangle: return "Round Rect";
184 case Folio::ShapeType::Circle: return "Circle";
185 case Folio::ShapeType::Ellipse: return "Ellipse";
186 case Folio::ShapeType::Triangle: return "Triangle";
187 case Folio::ShapeType::RightTriangle: return "Right Tri";
188 case Folio::ShapeType::Star: return "Star";
189 case Folio::ShapeType::Line: return "Line";
190 case Folio::ShapeType::LineArrow: return "Arrow";
191 case Folio::ShapeType::Hexagon:
192 case Folio::ShapeType::RegularPolygon: return "Polygon";
193 case Folio::ShapeType::Heart: return "Heart";
194 case Folio::ShapeType::Cloud: return "Cloud";
195 case Folio::ShapeType::SineWave: return "Sine Wave";
196 case Folio::ShapeType::SquareWave: return "Square Wave";
197 case Folio::ShapeType::TriangleWave: return "Triangle Wave";
198 case Folio::ShapeType::RightTriangleWave: return "Right Tri Wave";
199 default: return "Shape";
200 }
201 }

521 popDrawList->AddLine(ImVec2(lineX1, lineY), ImVec2(lineX2, lineY), strokeCol, traceThick);
522 } else if (s_Patterns[p].pattern == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dashed) {
523 float totalW = lineX2 - lineX1;
524 int numDashes = 3;
525 float gapW = 4.0f;
526 float dashW = (totalW - (numDashes - 1) * gapW) / numDashes;
527 for (int d = 0; d < numDashes; d++) {
528 float dx1 = lineX1 + d * (dashW + gapW);
529 float dx2 = dx1 + dashW;
530 popDrawList->AddLine(ImVec2(dx1, lineY), ImVec2(dx2, lineY), strokeCol, traceThick);
531 }
532 } else if (s_Patterns[p].pattern == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dotted) {
533 int numDots = 4;
534 float span = lineX2 - lineX1;
535 for (int d = 0; d < numDots; d++) {
536 float dotX = lineX1 + d * (span / (numDots - 1));
537 popDrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(dotX, lineY), 1.8f, strokeCol);
538 }
539 } else if (s_Patterns[p].pattern == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::DashDot) {
540 float totalW = lineX2 - lineX1;
541 float segW = totalW * 0.35f;
542 popDrawList->AddLine(ImVec2(lineX1, lineY), ImVec2(lineX1 + segW, lineY), strokeCol, traceThick);
543 popDrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(lineX1 + totalW * 0.5f, lineY), 1.8f, strokeCol);
544 popDrawList->AddLine(ImVec2(lineX2 - segW, lineY), ImVec2(lineX2, lineY), strokeCol, traceThick);
545 }
546
547 ImGui::PopStyleColor(3);
548 }
549
550 // 7. Connector / Smart Arrow Options (visible if line/arrow active or connector selected)
551 bool isConnectorMode = (canvas.shapeCreation.shapeType == Folio::ShapeType::Line ||
552 canvas.shapeCreation.shapeType == Folio::ShapeType::LineArrow ||
553 selectedConnector != nullptr);
554 if (isConnectorMode) {
555 ImGui::Spacing();
556 ImGui::Separator();
557 ImGui::Spacing();
558 ImGui::TextDisabled("Routing Style");
559 ImGui::Spacing();
560
561 static const char* s_Styles[] = { "Straight", "Curved", "Elbow" };
562 Folio::ConnectorStyle curStyle = selectedConnector ? selectedConnector->connectorStyle : canvas.shapeCreation.defaultConnectorStyle;
563 for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
564 if (s > 0) ImGui::SameLine(0, 5.0f);
565 bool isCur = (static_cast<int>(curStyle) == s);
566 if (isCur) {
567 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, theme.colorItemSelected);
568 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorItemSelectedText);
569 } else {
570 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, theme.colorPanel);
571 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorText);
572 }
573 std::string sBtnId = std::string(s_Styles[s]) + "##conn_style";
574 if (ImGui::Button(sBtnId.c_str(), ImVec2(66.0f, 26.0f))) {
575 canvas.shapeCreation.defaultConnectorStyle = static_cast<Folio::ConnectorStyle>(s);
576 if (selectedConnector) {
577 selectedConnector->connectorStyle = static_cast<Folio::ConnectorStyle>(s);
578 selectedConnector->UpdateBounds();
579 if (session) canvas.SyncSelectionToSpatialIndex(session);
580 }
581 canvas.needsFullRebake = true;
582 canvas.isDirty = true;
583 }
584 ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
585 }
586
587 ImGui::Spacing();
588 ImGui::TextDisabled("Arrow Cap");
589 ImGui::Spacing();
590
591 static const char* s_CapNames[] = { "None", "Triangle", "Stealth", "Open", "Circle" };
592 Folio::ArrowHeadType curCap = selectedConnector ? selectedConnector->endArrow : canvas.shapeCreation.defaultEndArrow;
593 for (int c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
594 if (c > 0 && c != 3) ImGui::SameLine(0, 5.0f);
595 bool isCur = (static_cast<int>(curCap) == c);
596 if (isCur) {
597 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, theme.colorItemSelected);
598 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorItemSelectedText);
599 } else {
600 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, theme.colorPanel);
601 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorText);
602 }
603 std::string cBtnId = std::string(s_CapNames[c]) + "##conn_cap";
604 if (ImGui::Button(cBtnId.c_str(), ImVec2(66.0f, 24.0f))) {
605 canvas.shapeCreation.defaultEndArrow = static_cast<Folio::ArrowHeadType>(c);
606 if (selectedConnector) {
607 selectedConnector->endArrow = static_cast<Folio::ArrowHeadType>(c);
608 selectedConnector->UpdateBounds();
609 }
610 canvas.needsFullRebake = true;
611 canvas.isDirty = true;
612 }
613 ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
614 }
615 }
616 }

618 /**
619 * @brief Renders an interactive vector shape split button.
620 *
621 * The main button displays the active shape's procedural vector icon and name.
622 * Clicking the main button jumps directly into the Shape Format tab (RibbonTab::ShapeFormat)
623 * and primes drawing mode for that shape.
624 * Right-clicking or clicking the chevron opens the full geometry, thickness, color,
625 * line style, and smart connector options menu (identical to pen nib controls).
626 */
627 void RenderShapeSplitButton(const char* strId, CanvasEngine& canvas, InputStateMachine& inputSM,
628 const ThemeManager& theme, bool isMini, bool jumpToFormatTab = true,
629 DocumentSession* currentSession = nullptr) {
630 ImDrawList* drawList = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
631 ImVec2 pos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
632 ImVec2 totalSize = isMini ? ImVec2(54.0f, 32.0f) : ImVec2(68.0f, 58.0f);
633 float chevronW = 16.0f;
634 float actionW = totalSize.x - chevronW;
635
636 Folio::ShapeType curShapeType = canvas.shapeCreation.shapeType;
637 const char* label = GetShapeTypeName(curShapeType);
638
639 ImGui::PushID(strId);
640
641 // 1. Action Zone (Left)
642 bool actionClicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##act_zone", ImVec2(actionW, totalSize.y));
643 bool actionHovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
644 bool actionActive = ImGui::IsItemActive();
645
646 // 2. Chevron Zone (Right)
647 ImGui::SameLine(0, 0);
648 bool chevronClicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##chev_zone", ImVec2(chevronW, totalSize.y));
649 bool chevronHovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
650 bool chevronActive = ImGui::IsItemActive();
651
652 bool isRightClicked = (actionHovered || chevronHovered) && ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Right);
653 bool isHeld = actionActive || chevronActive;
654 bool isActive = (inputSM.currentAction == InteractionState::DrawingShape);
655 ImVec2 pMin = pos;
656 ImVec2 pMax = ImVec2(pos.x + totalSize.x, pos.y + totalSize.y);
657 float rounding = theme.frameRounding;
658
659 if (isHeld) {
660 drawList->AddRectFilled(pMin, pMax, ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover), rounding);
661 ImU32 borderCol = (theme.colorBg.x < 0.5f) ? IM_COL32(0, 150, 255, 255) : IM_COL32(0, 120, 215, 255);
662 drawList->AddRect(pMin, pMax, borderCol, rounding, 0, 1.8f);
663 } else if (isActive) {
664 ImU32 bgCol = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32((actionHovered || chevronHovered) ? theme.colorItemHover : theme.colorItemSelected);
665 drawList->AddRectFilled(pMin, pMax, bgCol, rounding);
666 drawList->AddRect(pMin, pMax, ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), rounding, 0, 1.0f);
667 } else if (actionHovered || chevronHovered) {
668 drawList->AddRectFilled(pMin, pMax, ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover), rounding);
669 }
670
671 if (chevronHovered && !isActive && !isHeld) {
672 drawList->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(pos.x + actionW, pos.y), pMax,
673 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelected), rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight);
674 }
675
676 // Divider between action and chevron
677 drawList->AddLine(
678 ImVec2(pos.x + actionW, pos.y + 6.0f),
679 ImVec2(pos.x + actionW, pos.y + totalSize.y - 6.0f),
680 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 1.0f
681 );
682
683 // Vector Shape Icon in Action Zone
684 float iconW = totalSize.y < 40.0f ? 18.0f : 24.0f;
685 float iconH = totalSize.y < 40.0f ? 18.0f : 24.0f;
686 float iconX = pos.x + (actionW - iconW) * 0.5f;
687 float iconY = totalSize.y < 40.0f ? pos.y + (totalSize.y - iconH) * 0.5f : pos.y + 5.0f;
688
689 ImVec2 iconMin(iconX, iconY);
690 ImVec2 iconMax(iconX + iconW, iconY + iconH);
691 ImU32 strokeCol = isActive ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelectedText)
692 : ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(actionHovered ? theme.colorText : theme.colorItemText);
693 ImU32 fillCol = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.0f, 0.47f, 0.83f, 0.20f));
694
695 Folio::ShapeObject::DrawShapeIconImGui(drawList, curShapeType, iconMin, iconMax, strokeCol, fillCol);
696
697 // Label below icon
698 if (totalSize.y >= 40.0f && label) {
699 ImVec2 lblSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label);
700 float lblX = pos.x + (actionW - lblSize.x) * 0.5f;
701 float lblY = pos.y + totalSize.y - lblSize.y - 4.0f;
702 ImU32 textCol = isActive ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelectedText)
703 : ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(actionHovered ? theme.colorText : theme.colorTextMuted);
704 drawList->AddText(ImVec2(lblX, lblY), textCol, label);
705 }
706
707 // Chevron arrow
708 float chevCenterX = pos.x + actionW + chevronW * 0.5f;
709 float chevCenterY = pos.y + totalSize.y * 0.5f;
710 ImVec2 ch1(chevCenterX - 3.5f, chevCenterY - 2.0f);
711 ImVec2 ch2(chevCenterX + 3.5f, chevCenterY - 2.0f);
712 ImVec2 ch3(chevCenterX, chevCenterY + 2.5f);
713 drawList->AddTriangleFilled(ch1, ch2, ch3,
714 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(chevronHovered ? theme.colorText : theme.colorTextMuted));
715
716 // Tooltip
717 if ((actionHovered || chevronHovered) && ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayShort)) {
718 ImGui::BeginTooltip();
719 ImGui::Text("Active Shape: %s\nClick to draw shape. Right-click or arrow to customize color, weight, and style.", label);
720 ImGui::EndTooltip();
721 }
722
723 // Action Click: jump to Shape Format tab and prime drawing tool
724 if (actionClicked) {
725 SyncShapePenColor(canvas);
726 canvas.StartShapeCreation(curShapeType, canvas.shapeCreation.lockDrawingMode, currentSession);
727 inputSM.SetToolForDevice(inputSM.ActiveDevice, InteractionState::DrawingShape);
728 inputSM.currentAction = InteractionState::DrawingShape;
729 if (jumpToFormatTab) {
730 previousTab = activeTab;
731 activeTab = RibbonTab::ShapeFormat;
732 tabTransitionTimer = 0.0f;
733 }
734 }
735
736 std::string popupId = std::string("##popup_shape_grid_") + strId;
737 if (chevronClicked || isRightClicked) {
738 ImGui::OpenPopup(popupId.c_str());
739 }
740
741 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(12, 12));
742 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_PopupRounding, 10.0f);
743 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PopupBg, theme.colorPanel);
744 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, theme.colorBorder);
745
746 if (ImGui::BeginPopup(popupId.c_str())) {
747 RenderShapeGridPalette(canvas, inputSM, theme, currentSession);
748 ImGui::EndPopup();
749 }
750
751 ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
752 ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
753
754 ImGui::PopID();
755 }

757 /**

761 void RenderShapeOutlineColorDisc(CanvasEngine& canvas, const ThemeManager& theme,

770 ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(btnPos);

791 } else {
792 drawList->AddCircle(center, outerRadius, ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 0, 1.0f);
793 }
794
795 drawList->AddCircleFilled(center, innerRadius, ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(colVec));

798 if (hovered && ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayShort)) {

808 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(12, 12));

810 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PopupBg, theme.colorPanel);
811 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, theme.colorBorder);
812
813 if (ImGui::BeginPopup(popupId.c_str())) {
814 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Outline Color");
815 ImGui::Separator();
816 ImGui::Spacing();
817
818 static const BLRgba32 s_palette[] = {
819 BLRgba32(0x18, 0x1A, 0x20, 0xFF), // Dark charcoal
820 BLRgba32(0x00, 0x78, 0xD4, 0xFF), // Accent Blue
821 BLRgba32(0x10, 0x7C, 0x41, 0xFF), // Green
822 BLRgba32(0xD8, 0x3B, 0x01, 0xFF), // Orange
823 BLRgba32(0xE8, 0x11, 0x23, 0xFF), // Red
824 BLRgba32(0x5C, 0x2D, 0x91, 0xFF), // Purple
825 BLRgba32(0x00, 0x82, 0x72, 0xFF), // Teal
826 BLRgba32(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) // White
827 };
828
829 for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {

831 ImGui::PushID(i + 3100);
832 const auto& c = s_palette[i];

834 if (ImGui::ColorButton("##strk_btn", cv, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip, ImVec2(24, 24))) {
835 canvas.shapeCreation.defaultOutlineColor = c;

845 ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
846 }
847 ImGui::PopID();

849
850 ImGui::Spacing();
851 ImGui::Separator();
852 ImGui::Spacing();
853
854 float arr[4] = { colVec.x, colVec.y, colVec.z, colVec.w };
855 if (ImGui::ColorPicker4("##outline_color_picker", arr,
856 ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHex | ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueBar)) {
857 BLRgba32 newCol(
858 static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(arr[0] * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f)),
859 static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(arr[1] * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f)),
860 static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(arr[2] * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f)),
861 static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(arr[3] * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f))
862 );
863 canvas.shapeCreation.defaultOutlineColor = newCol;
864 if (selectedShape) {
865 selectedShape->strokeColor = newCol;
866 canvas.needsFullRebake = true;
867 canvas.isDirty = true;
868 } else if (selectedConnector) {
869 selectedConnector->strokeColor = newCol;
870 canvas.needsFullRebake = true;
871 canvas.isDirty = true;
872 }
873 }
874
875 ImGui::EndPopup();
876 }
877
878 ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
879 ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);

996 BLRgba32(0xFF, 0xB9, 0x00, 0xFF),

998 };

1000 for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {

1017 }
1018
1019 ImGui::Spacing();
1020 ImGui::Separator();
1021 ImGui::Spacing();
1022
1023 float arr[4] = { colVec.x, colVec.y, colVec.z, colVec.w };
1024 if (ImGui::ColorPicker4("##infill_color_picker", arr,
1025 ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHex | ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueBar)) {

1053 /**
1054 * @brief Renders the Outline Style dropdown button and interactive menu (Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Dash-Dot, None).
1055 * Provides rich graphical preview lines for each option matching the drawing pen style menu.
1056 */
1057 void RenderShapeOutlineStyleDropdown(CanvasEngine& canvas, const ThemeManager& theme,
1058 std::shared_ptr<Folio::ShapeObject> selectedShape, bool isMini, DocumentSession* currentSession) {
1059 ImDrawList* drawList = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();

1061 float btnW = isMini ? 42.0f : 74.0f;
1062 float btnH = isMini ? 32.0f : 58.0f;
1063 ImVec2 btnPos(startPos.x, startPos.y);
1064
1065 ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(btnPos);
1066 std::string popupId = "##shape_outline_style_popup";
1067
1068 bool clicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##shape_outline_style_btn", ImVec2(btnW, btnH));
1069 bool hovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
1070 bool pressed = ImGui::IsItemActive();
1071
1072 Folio::ShapeOutlineType curOut = selectedShape ? selectedShape->outlineType : canvas.shapeCreation.defaultOutlineType;

1076 if (pressed) {

1079 } else if (hovered) {
1080 drawList->AddRectFilled(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover), 6.0f);
1081 drawList->AddRect(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 6.0f, 0, 1.0f);
1082 } else {
1083 drawList->AddRect(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 6.0f, 0, 1.0f);
1084 }
1085
1086 // Graphical preview on the button
1087 float previewY = btnPos.y + (isMini ? btnH * 0.5f : 16.0f);
1088 float px1 = btnPos.x + 8.0f;
1089 float px2 = btnPos.x + btnW - 8.0f;
1090 float pThick = 2.5f;
1091
1092 if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Solid) {
1093 drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(px1, previewY), ImVec2(px2, previewY), inkU32, pThick);
1094 } else if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dashed) {
1095 float seg = 10.0f, gap = 5.0f;
1096 drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(px1, previewY), ImVec2(px1 + seg, previewY), inkU32, pThick);
1097 drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(px1 + seg + gap, previewY), ImVec2(px2, previewY), inkU32, pThick);
1098 } else if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dotted) {
1099 float dotR = 2.0f;
1100 float span = px2 - px1;
1101 for (int d = 0; d <= 3; d++) {
1102 drawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(px1 + d * (span / 3.0f), previewY), dotR, inkU32);
1103 }
1104 } else if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::DashDot) {
1105 float seg = 14.0f;
1106 drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(px1, previewY), ImVec2(px1 + seg, previewY), inkU32, pThick);
1107 drawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(px1 + seg + 6.0f, previewY), 2.0f, inkU32);
1108 drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(px1 + seg + 12.0f, previewY), ImVec2(px2, previewY), inkU32, pThick);
1109 } else {
1110 // None / borderless
1111 drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(px1, previewY), ImVec2(px2, previewY), IM_COL32(232, 17, 35, 180), 1.8f);
1112 drawList->AddLine(ImVec2((px1 + px2) * 0.5f - 4.0f, previewY - 4.0f), ImVec2((px1 + px2) * 0.5f + 4.0f, previewY + 4.0f), IM_COL32(232, 17, 35, 240), 2.0f);
1113 }
1114
1115 // Label below preview
1116 if (!isMini) {
1117 const char* sLabel = "Solid";
1118 if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Solid) sLabel = "Solid";
1119 else if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dashed) sLabel = "Dashed";
1120 else if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dotted) sLabel = "Dotted";
1121 else if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::DashDot) sLabel = "Dash-Dot";
1122 else if (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::None) sLabel = "None";
1123
1124 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontRibbonSection ? FolioTheme::FontRibbonSection : FolioTheme::FontRegular);
1125 ImVec2 txtSz = ImGui::CalcTextSize(sLabel);
1126 float txtX = btnPos.x + (btnW - txtSz.x) * 0.5f;
1127 float txtY = btnPos.y + btnH - txtSz.y - 4.0f;
1128 drawList->AddText(ImVec2(txtX, txtY), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorText), sLabel);
1129 ImGui::PopFont();
1130 }
1131
1132 if (hovered && ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayShort)) {
1133 ImGui::BeginTooltip();
1134 const char* outDesc = (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dotted) ? "Dotted Outline" :
1135 (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dashed) ? "Dashed Outline" :
1136 (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::DashDot) ? "Dash-Dot Outline" :
1137 (curOut == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::None) ? "No Outline (Borderless)" : "Solid Outline";
1138 ImGui::Text("Outline Pattern: %s", outDesc);
1139 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorTextMuted);
1140 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Click to select border stroke pattern");
1141 ImGui::PopStyleColor();
1142 ImGui::EndTooltip();
1143 }
1144
1145 if (clicked) {
1146 ImGui::OpenPopup(popupId.c_str());
1147 }
1148
1149 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(12, 12));
1150 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_PopupRounding, 10.0f);
1151 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PopupBg, theme.colorPanel);
1152 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, theme.colorBorder);
1153
1154 if (ImGui::BeginPopup(popupId.c_str())) {
1155 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Select Outline Style");
1156 ImGui::Separator();
1157 ImGui::Spacing();
1158
1159 struct OutlineItem {
1160 const char* name;
1161 Folio::ShapeOutlineType type;
1162 const char* desc;
1163 };
1164 static const OutlineItem s_OutItems[] = {
1165 { "Solid Line", Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Solid, "Continuous unbroken stroke" },
1166 { "Dashed Line", Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dashed, "Evenly spaced line dashes" },
1167 { "Dotted Line", Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dotted, "Crisp circular dots trace" },
1168 { "Dash-Dot", Folio::ShapeOutlineType::DashDot, "Alternating dash and dot" },
1169 { "None", Folio::ShapeOutlineType::None, "Borderless / invisible outline" }
1170 };
1171
1172 for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
1173 bool isSelected = (curOut == s_OutItems[i].type);
1174 ImGui::PushID(i + 4000);
1175
1176 ImVec2 itemPos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
1177 float itemW = 210.0f;
1178 float itemH = 34.0f;
1179 bool itemClicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##out_row", ImVec2(itemW, itemH));
1180 bool itemHovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
1181
1182 ImDrawList* popDl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
1183 if (isSelected) {
1184 popDl->AddRectFilled(itemPos, ImVec2(itemPos.x + itemW, itemPos.y + itemH),
1185 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelected), 6.0f);
1186 popDl->AddRect(itemPos, ImVec2(itemPos.x + itemW, itemPos.y + itemH),
1187 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 6.0f, 0, 1.2f);
1188 } else if (itemHovered) {
1189 popDl->AddRectFilled(itemPos, ImVec2(itemPos.x + itemW, itemPos.y + itemH),
1190 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover), 6.0f);
1191 }
1192
1193 // Graphical preview line
1194 float sampleY = itemPos.y + itemH * 0.5f;
1195 float sx1 = itemPos.x + 10.0f;
1196 float sx2 = itemPos.x + 55.0f;
1197 ImU32 sCol = isSelected ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelectedText) : inkU32;
1198
1199 if (s_OutItems[i].type == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Solid) {
1200 popDl->AddLine(ImVec2(sx1, sampleY), ImVec2(sx2, sampleY), sCol, 3.0f);
1201 } else if (s_OutItems[i].type == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dashed) {
1202 float dW = 12.0f, gW = 6.0f;
1203 popDl->AddLine(ImVec2(sx1, sampleY), ImVec2(sx1 + dW, sampleY), sCol, 3.0f);
1204 popDl->AddLine(ImVec2(sx1 + dW + gW, sampleY), ImVec2(sx2, sampleY), sCol, 3.0f);
1205 } else if (s_OutItems[i].type == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::Dotted) {
1206 for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
1207 popDl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(sx1 + d * 14.0f, sampleY), 2.2f, sCol);
1208 }
1209 } else if (s_OutItems[i].type == Folio::ShapeOutlineType::DashDot) {
1210 float dW = 14.0f;
1211 popDl->AddLine(ImVec2(sx1, sampleY), ImVec2(sx1 + dW, sampleY), sCol, 3.0f);
1212 popDl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(sx1 + dW + 6.0f, sampleY), 2.2f, sCol);
1213 popDl->AddLine(ImVec2(sx1 + dW + 12.0f, sampleY), ImVec2(sx2, sampleY), sCol, 3.0f);
1214 } else {
1215 // None
1216 popDl->AddLine(ImVec2(sx1, sampleY), ImVec2(sx2, sampleY), IM_COL32(232, 17, 35, 180), 2.0f);
1217 popDl->AddLine(ImVec2((sx1 + sx2) * 0.5f - 4.0f, sampleY - 4.0f), ImVec2((sx1 + sx2) * 0.5f + 4.0f, sampleY + 4.0f), IM_COL32(232, 17, 35, 240), 2.0f);
1218 }
1219
1220 // Label text & description
1221 // Dynamically center the two-line text block (name + desc) vertically within the item row.
1222 // Math: totalTextH = nameSz.y + descSz.y + 2px gap
1223 // startY = itemPos.y + (itemH - totalTextH) * 0.5
1224 {
1225 ImGui::PushFont(nullptr); // use default ImGui font
1226 ImVec2 nameSz = ImGui::CalcTextSize(s_OutItems[i].name);
1227 ImVec2 descSz = ImGui::CalcTextSize(s_OutItems[i].desc);
1228 ImGui::PopFont();
1229 float gap = 2.0f;
1230 float totalH = nameSz.y + descSz.y + gap;
1231 float startY = itemPos.y + (itemH - totalH) * 0.5f;
1232 float textX = itemPos.x + 65.0f;
1233
1234 ImU32 textCol = isSelected ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelectedText) : ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorText);
1235 popDl->AddText(ImVec2(textX, startY), textCol, s_OutItems[i].name);
1236
1237 ImU32 descCol = isSelected ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelectedText) : ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorTextMuted);
1238 popDl->AddText(ImVec2(textX, startY + nameSz.y + gap), descCol, s_OutItems[i].desc);
1239 }
1240
1241 if (itemClicked) {
1242 canvas.shapeCreation.defaultOutlineType = s_OutItems[i].type;
1243 if (selectedShape) {
1244 selectedShape->outlineType = s_OutItems[i].type;
1245 selectedShape->UpdateBounds();
1246 if (currentSession) canvas.SyncSelectionToSpatialIndex(currentSession);
1247 canvas.selectionGizmo.RecalculateBounds();
1248 canvas.needsFullRebake = true;
1249 canvas.isDirty = true;
1250 }
1251 ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
1252 }
1253
1254 ImGui::PopID();
1255 }
1256
1257 ImGui::EndPopup();
1258 }
1259
1260 ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
1261 ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);

1264 /**
1265 * @brief Renders the Infill Style & Drafting Texture dropdown button and popup menu.
1266 * Supports Solid, Translucent, Drafting Diagonal (///), Drafting Cross-Hatch (XXX),
1267 * Horizontal (---), Vertical (|||), Stipple (dots), and None.
1268 */
1269 void RenderShapeInfillStyleDropdown(CanvasEngine& canvas, const ThemeManager& theme,
1270 std::shared_ptr<Folio::ShapeObject> selectedShape, bool isMini, DocumentSession* currentSession) {
1271 ImDrawList* drawList = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
1272 ImVec2 startPos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
1273 float btnW = isMini ? 42.0f : 84.0f;
1274 float btnH = isMini ? 32.0f : 58.0f;
1275 ImVec2 btnPos(startPos.x, startPos.y);
1276
1277 ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(btnPos);
1278 std::string popupId = "##shape_infill_style_popup";
1279
1280 bool clicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##shape_infill_style_btn", ImVec2(btnW, btnH));
1281 bool hovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
1282 bool pressed = ImGui::IsItemActive();
1283
1284 Folio::ShapeFillType curFill = selectedShape ? selectedShape->fillType : canvas.shapeCreation.defaultFillType;
1285 BLRgba32 curCol = selectedShape ? selectedShape->fillColor : canvas.shapeCreation.defaultFillColor;
1286 ImVec4 colVec(curCol.r() / 255.0f, curCol.g() / 255.0f, curCol.b() / 255.0f, 1.0f);
1287 ImU32 fillU32 = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(colVec);
1288
1289 if (pressed) {
1290 drawList->AddRectFilled(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelected), 6.0f);
1291 drawList->AddRect(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 6.0f, 0, 1.2f);
1292 } else if (hovered) {
1293 drawList->AddRectFilled(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover), 6.0f);
1294 drawList->AddRect(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 6.0f, 0, 1.0f);
1295 } else {
1296 drawList->AddRect(btnPos, ImVec2(btnPos.x + btnW, btnPos.y + btnH), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 6.0f, 0, 1.0f);
1297 }
1298
1299 // Swatch Box preview on button
1300 float bx1 = btnPos.x + (btnW - 28.0f) * 0.5f;
1301 float by1 = btnPos.y + (isMini ? (btnH - 18.0f) * 0.5f : 8.0f);
1302 float bx2 = bx1 + 28.0f;
1303 float by2 = by1 + 18.0f;
1304
1305 // Draw swatch border
1306 drawList->AddRect(ImVec2(bx1, by1), ImVec2(bx2, by2), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 3.0f);
1307
1308 // Helper lambda to render infill swatch graphics
1309 auto drawSwatch = [&](ImDrawList* dl, ImVec2 p1, ImVec2 p2, Folio::ShapeFillType ft, ImU32 col) {
1310 dl->PushClipRect(p1, p2, true);
1311 if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::None) {
1312 // Diagonal red slash
1313 dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p1.x + 2, p2.y - 2), ImVec2(p2.x - 2, p1.y + 2), IM_COL32(232, 17, 35, 240), 2.0f);
1314 } else if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::Solid) {
1315 dl->AddRectFilled(p1, p2, col, 2.0f);
1316 } else if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::SemiTransparent) {
1317 ImVec4 tcol = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(col);
1318 tcol.w = 0.35f;
1319 dl->AddRectFilled(p1, p2, ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(tcol), 2.0f);
1320 } else if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDiagonal) {
1321 for (float off = -30.0f; off < 50.0f; off += 6.0f) {
1322 dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p1.x + off, p2.y), ImVec2(p1.x + off + 20.0f, p1.y), col, 1.5f);
1323 }
1324 } else if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchCross) {
1325 for (float off = -30.0f; off < 50.0f; off += 7.0f) {
1326 dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p1.x + off, p2.y), ImVec2(p1.x + off + 20.0f, p1.y), col, 1.3f);
1327 dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p1.x + off, p1.y), ImVec2(p1.x + off + 20.0f, p2.y), col, 1.3f);
1328 }
1329 } else if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchHorizontal) {
1330 for (float y = p1.y + 3.0f; y < p2.y; y += 4.5f) {
1331 dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p1.x, y), ImVec2(p2.x, y), col, 1.4f);
1332 }
1333 } else if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchVertical) {
1334 for (float x = p1.x + 3.0f; x < p2.x; x += 4.5f) {
1335 dl->AddLine(ImVec2(x, p1.y), ImVec2(x, p2.y), col, 1.4f);
1336 }
1337 } else if (ft == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDots) {
1338 for (float y = p1.y + 3.0f; y < p2.y; y += 5.0f) {
1339 for (float x = p1.x + 3.0f; x < p2.x; x += 5.0f) {
1340 dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x, y), 1.2f, col);
1341 }
1342 }
1343 } else {
1344 // Gradient
1345 dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(p1, p2, col, col, IM_COL32(0, 196, 255, 120), IM_COL32(0, 196, 255, 120));
1346 }
1347 dl->PopClipRect();
1348 };
1349
1350 drawSwatch(drawList, ImVec2(bx1, by1), ImVec2(bx2, by2), curFill, fillU32);
1351
1352 // Label below preview
1353 if (!isMini) {
1354 const char* sLabel = "Solid";
1355 switch (curFill) {
1356 case Folio::ShapeFillType::None: sLabel = "No Fill"; break;
1357 case Folio::ShapeFillType::Solid: sLabel = "Solid"; break;
1358 case Folio::ShapeFillType::SemiTransparent: sLabel = "Translucent"; break;
1359 case Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDiagonal: sLabel = "Diagonal"; break;
1360 case Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchCross: sLabel = "Cross-Hatch"; break;
1361 case Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchHorizontal: sLabel = "Horizontal"; break;
1362 case Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchVertical: sLabel = "Vertical"; break;
1363 case Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDots: sLabel = "Stipple"; break;
1364 case Folio::ShapeFillType::LinearGradient: sLabel = "Linear Grad"; break;
1365 case Folio::ShapeFillType::RadialGradient: sLabel = "Radial Grad"; break;
1366 default: break;
1367 }
1368
1369 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontRibbonSection ? FolioTheme::FontRibbonSection : FolioTheme::FontRegular);
1370 ImVec2 txtSz = ImGui::CalcTextSize(sLabel);
1371 float txtX = btnPos.x + (btnW - txtSz.x) * 0.5f;
1372 float txtY = btnPos.y + btnH - txtSz.y - 4.0f;
1373 drawList->AddText(ImVec2(txtX, txtY), ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorText), sLabel);
1374 ImGui::PopFont();
1375 }
1376
1377 if (hovered && ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayShort)) {
1378 ImGui::BeginTooltip();
1379 ImGui::Text("Infill Style: %s", (curFill == Folio::ShapeFillType::None) ? "No Fill (Transparent)" :
1380 (curFill == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDiagonal) ? "Drafting Diagonal (///)" :
1381 (curFill == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchCross) ? "Drafting Cross-Hatch (XXX)" :
1382 (curFill == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchHorizontal) ? "Horizontal Lines (---)" :
1383 (curFill == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchVertical) ? "Vertical Lines (|||)" :
1384 (curFill == Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDots) ? "Drafting Stipple (Dots)" :
1385 (curFill == Folio::ShapeFillType::SemiTransparent) ? "Translucent Wash" : "Solid Fill");
1386 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorTextMuted);
1387 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Click to select drafting hatches, textures, or solid infill");
1388 ImGui::PopStyleColor();

1396 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(12, 12));

1400
1401 if (ImGui::BeginPopup(popupId.c_str())) {
1402 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Select Infill Style & Drafting Texture");
1403 ImGui::Separator();
1404 ImGui::Spacing();
1405
1406 struct InfillItem {

1411 static const InfillItem s_FillItems[] = {
1412 { "No Fill", Folio::ShapeFillType::None, "Completely transparent interior" },
1413 { "Solid Infill", Folio::ShapeFillType::Solid, "Opaque solid color fill" },
1414 { "Translucent Infill", Folio::ShapeFillType::SemiTransparent, "Soft translucent color wash" },
1415 { "Drafting Diagonal", Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDiagonal, "45-deg parallel drafting hatch lines (///)" },
1416 { "Drafting Cross-Hatch", Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchCross, "Intersecting 45-deg drafting grid (XXX)" },
1417 { "Horizontal Lines", Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchHorizontal, "Parallel horizontal drafting lines (---)" },
1418 { "Vertical Lines", Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchVertical, "Parallel vertical drafting lines (|||)" },
1419 { "Drafting Stipple", Folio::ShapeFillType::HatchDots, "Fine dotted grain texture (sand/concrete)" },
1420 { "Linear Gradient", Folio::ShapeFillType::LinearGradient, "Smooth two-stop directional blend" },
1421 { "Radial Gradient", Folio::ShapeFillType::RadialGradient, "Concentric center-outward blend" }
1422 };
1423
1424 for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
1425 bool isSelected = (curFill == s_FillItems[i].type);
1426 ImGui::PushID(i + 5000);
1427
1428 ImVec2 itemPos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
1429 float itemW = 260.0f;
1430 float itemH = 36.0f;

1432 bool itemHovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();

1438 popDl->AddRect(itemPos, ImVec2(itemPos.x + itemW, itemPos.y + itemH),
1439 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 6.0f, 0, 1.2f);

1441 popDl->AddRectFilled(itemPos, ImVec2(itemPos.x + itemW, itemPos.y + itemH),
1442 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover), 6.0f);
1443 }

1445 // Swatch preview box on left

1447 ImVec2 sw2(sw1.x + 28.0f, sw1.y + 24.0f);

1453 // Label text & description

1457 {

1471 popDl->AddText(ImVec2(textX, startY + nameSz.y + gap), descCol, s_FillItems[i].desc);
1472 }

1494 void Render(float width, AppViewMode& outViewMode, CanvasEngine& canvas, InputStateMachine& inputSM, const ThemeManager& theme, DocumentSession* session = nullptr) {
1495 if (session) currentSession = session;
1496 float dt = ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime;
1497 if (dt > 0.0f && dt < 0.1f) {
1498 animatedHeight += (GetTargetHeight() - animatedHeight) * (1.0f - std::exp(-dt * 20.0f));
1499 if (std::abs(animatedHeight - GetTargetHeight()) < 0.25f) {
1500 animatedHeight = GetTargetHeight();
1501 }
1502 }
1503 if (tabTransitionTimer < 1.0f) {
1504 tabTransitionTimer += dt * 7.0f;
1505 if (tabTransitionTimer > 1.0f) tabTransitionTimer = 1.0f;
1506 }
1507
1508 if (animatedHeight <= 0.5f) return;
1509 if (width <= 0.0f) width = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
1510
1511 // 1. Unified Modern Ribbon Tabs Row ("File" + All Ribbon Tabs)
1512 // Fixed slot widths computed via FontRibbonBoldLarge so tabs NEVER shift when active tab changes!
1513 ImDrawList* drawList = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
1514
1515 // Check for contextual selected shape or connector and handle auto-tab navigation
1516 auto selectedShape = canvas.GetSelectedShape(session ? session : currentSession);
1517 auto selectedConnector = canvas.GetSelectedConnector(session ? session : currentSession);
1518 auto selectedTextBox = canvas.GetSelectedTextBox(session ? session : currentSession);
1519 static uint32_t s_lastSelectedShapeUid = 0;
1520 static uint32_t s_lastSelectedTextUid = 0;
1521 uint32_t currentShapeUid = selectedShape ? selectedShape->uid : (selectedConnector ? selectedConnector->uid : 0);
1522 uint32_t currentTextUid = selectedTextBox ? selectedTextBox->uid : 0;
1523
1524 // Auto-switch to ShapeFormat tab ONLY when a shape or connector is newly selected
1525 if (selectedShape || selectedConnector) {
1526 if (s_lastSelectedShapeUid != currentShapeUid && activeTab != RibbonTab::ShapeFormat) {
1527 previousTab = activeTab;
1528 activeTab = RibbonTab::ShapeFormat;
1529 tabTransitionTimer = 0.0f;
1530 }
1531 }
1532 // If user is actively inking and no shape/connector is selected, return to previous tab / Draw
1533 if (inputSM.currentAction == InteractionState::Inking && activeTab == RibbonTab::ShapeFormat && !selectedShape && !selectedConnector) {
1534 activeTab = (previousTab != RibbonTab::ShapeFormat) ? previousTab : RibbonTab::Draw;
1535 tabTransitionTimer = 0.0f;
1536 }
1537 s_lastSelectedShapeUid = currentShapeUid;
1538 s_lastSelectedTextUid = currentTextUid;
1539
1540 struct TabDef {
1541 const char* name;
1542 bool isFile;
1543 RibbonTab tabEnum;
1544 bool isContextual = false;
1545 };
1546
1547 std::vector<TabDef> tabs = {
1548 { "File", true, RibbonTab::Home, false },
1549 { "Home", false, RibbonTab::Home, false },
1550 { "Insert", false, RibbonTab::Insert, false },
1551 { "Draw", false, RibbonTab::Draw, false },
1552 { "View", false, RibbonTab::View, false }
1553 };
1554
1555 auto currentDocSession = session ? session : currentSession;
1556 auto activePg = currentDocSession ? currentDocSession->GetActivePage() : nullptr;
1557 bool isDedicatedPdf = activePg && activePg->isDedicatedPdf;
1558
1559 // Keep Shape Format tab visible while on that tab, while drawing shapes, or while a shape/connector is selected
1560 bool showShapeFormat = (selectedShape != nullptr) || (selectedConnector != nullptr) || (activeTab == RibbonTab::ShapeFormat) || (inputSM.currentAction == InteractionState::DrawingShape);
1561 if (showShapeFormat) {
1562 tabs.push_back({ "Shape Format", false, RibbonTab::ShapeFormat, true });
1563 }
1564 if (isDedicatedPdf || activeTab == RibbonTab::PdfTools) {
1565 tabs.push_back({ "PDF Tools", false, RibbonTab::PdfTools, true });
1566 }
1567 if (!isDedicatedPdf && activeTab == RibbonTab::PdfTools) {
1568 activeTab = (previousTab != RibbonTab::PdfTools) ? previousTab : RibbonTab::Draw;
1569 }
1570 const int numTabs = static_cast<int>(tabs.size());
1571
1572 std::vector<float> tabWidths(numTabs);
1573 std::vector<float> boldTextWidths(numTabs);
1574 float totalTabsWidth = 0.0f;
1575 const float tabSpacing = 4.0f;
1576
1577 ImFont* boldMeasureFont = FolioTheme::FontRibbonBoldLarge ? FolioTheme::FontRibbonBoldLarge : FolioTheme::FontRibbonLarge;
1578 ImGui::PushFont(boldMeasureFont);
1579 for (int i = 0; i < numTabs; ++i) {
1580 boldTextWidths[i] = ImGui::CalcTextSize(tabs[i].name).x;
1581 tabWidths[i] = std::max(boldTextWidths[i] + 28.0f, tabs[i].isFile ? 76.0f : 86.0f);
1582 totalTabsWidth += tabWidths[i];
1583 if (i > 0) totalTabsWidth += tabSpacing;
1584 }
1585 ImGui::PopFont();
1586
1587 // Center the ribbon category selection row across ribbon width
1588 float startX = (width - totalTabsWidth) * 0.5f;
1589 if (startX < 10.0f) startX = 10.0f;
1590 if (startX + totalTabsWidth > width - 200.0f) {
1591 startX = std::max(10.0f, width - 200.0f - totalTabsWidth);
1592 }
1593
1594 ImGui::SetCursorPos(ImVec2(startX, 4.0f));
1595
1596 for (int i = 0; i < numTabs; ++i) {
1597 const auto& tab = tabs[i];
1598 bool isSelected = tab.isFile
1599 ? (outViewMode == AppViewMode::NotebookHub)
1600 : (activeTab == tab.tabEnum && (displayMode != RibbonDisplayMode::Collapsed || isCollapsedPopupOpen) && outViewMode == AppViewMode::CanvasWorkspace);
1601
1602 ImGui::PushID(i);
1603 ImVec2 tabPos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
1604
1605 // FIXED SLOT WIDTH: Pre-measured so slot width NEVER changes when tab is selected or hovered
1606 float boldTextW = boldTextWidths[i];
1607 float tabWidth = tabWidths[i];
1608 float tabHeight = 48.0f;
1609
1610 // Invisible button for clean interaction without bounding boxes
1611 bool clicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton(tab.name, ImVec2(tabWidth, tabHeight));
1612 bool isHovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
1613
1614 if (clicked) {
1615 if (tab.isFile) {
1616 isCollapsedPopupOpen = false;
1617 outViewMode = (outViewMode == AppViewMode::NotebookHub)
1618 ? AppViewMode::CanvasWorkspace
1619 : AppViewMode::NotebookHub;
1620 } else {
1621 if (outViewMode == AppViewMode::NotebookHub) outViewMode = AppViewMode::CanvasWorkspace;
1622 if (displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode::Collapsed) {
1623 if (isCollapsedPopupOpen && activeTab == tab.tabEnum) {
1624 // Clicking the already open tab toggles it closed
1625 isCollapsedPopupOpen = false;
1626 } else {
1627 // Open floating popup for this tab without moving the canvas
1628 if (tab.tabEnum != RibbonTab::ShapeFormat) {
1629 canvas.shapeCreation.lockDrawingMode = false;
1630 canvas.shapeCreation.isActive = false;
1631 }
1632 previousTab = activeTab;
1633 activeTab = tab.tabEnum;
1634 isCollapsedPopupOpen = true;
1635 tabTransitionTimer = 1.0f;
1636 if (isDedicatedPdf && activeTab == RibbonTab::Draw) {
1637 auto* pv = Folio::PdfViewerPage::GetActiveInstance();
1638 inputSM.SetToolForDevice(inputSM.ActiveDevice, InteractionState::Inking);
1639 inputSM.currentAction = InteractionState::Inking;
1640 if (pv) pv->activeTool = Folio::PdfToolMode::Pen;
1641 }
1642 }
1643 } else {
1644 if (activeTab == tab.tabEnum) {
1645 ToggleCollapse();
1646 } else {
1647 if (activeTab != tab.tabEnum) {
1648 if (tab.tabEnum != RibbonTab::ShapeFormat) {
1649 canvas.shapeCreation.lockDrawingMode = false;
1650 canvas.shapeCreation.isActive = false;
1651 }
1652 previousTab = activeTab;
1653 activeTab = tab.tabEnum;
1654 tabTransitionTimer = 0.0f; // Smooth fade-in
1655 if (isDedicatedPdf && activeTab == RibbonTab::Draw) {
1656 auto* pv = Folio::PdfViewerPage::GetActiveInstance();
1657 inputSM.SetToolForDevice(inputSM.ActiveDevice, InteractionState::Inking);
1658 inputSM.currentAction = InteractionState::Inking;
1659 if (pv) pv->activeTool = Folio::PdfToolMode::Pen;
1660 }
1661 }
1662 if (displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode::FullyHidden) {
1663 SetDisplayMode(previousActiveMode);
1664 }
1665 }
1666 }
1667 }
1668 }
1669
1670 // Double-clicking a tab pins/uncollapses into FullRibbon mode
1671 if (isHovered && ImGui::IsMouseDoubleClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left)) {
1672 if (displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode::Collapsed) {
1673 isCollapsedPopupOpen = false;
1674 SetDisplayMode(RibbonDisplayMode::FullRibbon);
1675 }
1676 }
1677
1678 // Contextual tabs (e.g. PDF Tools, Shape Format) elevated visual styling:
1679 // Instead of coloring text the same color as the header (which rendered orange-on-orange invisible text),
1680 // draw an elevated translucent pill container with border and clean bright typography.
1681 if (tab.isContextual) {
1682 ImU32 pillBg = isSelected
1683 ? IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 60)
1684 : (isHovered ? IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 38) : IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 20));
1685 ImU32 pillBorder = IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, isSelected ? 120 : 50);
1686 drawList->AddRectFilled(
1687 ImVec2(tabPos.x + 2.0f, tabPos.y + 6.0f),
1688 ImVec2(tabPos.x + tabWidth - 2.0f, tabPos.y + tabHeight - 6.0f),
1689 pillBg,
1690 8.0f
1691 );
1692 drawList->AddRect(
1693 ImVec2(tabPos.x + 2.0f, tabPos.y + 6.0f),
1694 ImVec2(tabPos.x + tabWidth - 2.0f, tabPos.y + tabHeight - 6.0f),
1695 pillBorder,
1696 8.0f,
1697 0,
1698 1.0f
1699 );
1700 }
1701
1702 // Draw Clean Modern Typography
1703 ImFont* font = isSelected ? FolioTheme::FontRibbonBoldLarge : FolioTheme::FontRibbonLarge;
1704 ImGui::PushFont(font);
1705 ImVec2 currentTextSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(tab.name);
1706 float textX = tabPos.x + (tabWidth - currentTextSize.x) * 0.5f;
1707 float textY = tabPos.y + (tabHeight - currentTextSize.y) * 0.5f - 1.0f;
1708 ImU32 textCol = isSelected
1709 ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorHeaderText)
1710 : (isHovered ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorTabHoverText) : ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorHeaderTextMuted));
1711
1712 drawList->AddText(ImVec2(textX, textY), textCol, tab.name);
1713 ImGui::PopFont();
1714
1715 // Underline Indicator: Glowing White with a crisp gap above the shelf
1716 float lineW = boldTextW + 10.0f; // Stable underline width centered in slot!
1717 float lineX1 = tabPos.x + (tabWidth - lineW) * 0.5f;
1718 float lineX2 = lineX1 + lineW;
1719 float lineY = tabPos.y + 49.0f; // Gap between underline and shelf at 58.0f
1720
1721 if (isSelected) {
1722 // 1. Soft glowing aura bloom
1723 drawList->AddLine(
1724 ImVec2(lineX1 - 2.0f, lineY),
1725 ImVec2(lineX2 + 2.0f, lineY),
1726 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorTabGlow),
1727 5.0f
1728 );
1729 // 2. Crisp glowing white core line
1730 drawList->AddLine(
1731 ImVec2(lineX1, lineY),
1732 ImVec2(lineX2, lineY),
1733 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorTabUnderline),
1734 3.0f
1735 );
1736 } else if (isHovered) {
1737 // Subtle faint preview indicator on hover
1738 drawList->AddLine(
1739 ImVec2(lineX1 + 4.0f, lineY),
1740 ImVec2(lineX2 - 4.0f, lineY),
1741 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorTabHoverUnderline),
1742 2.0f
1743 );
1744 }
1745
1746 ImGui::PopID();
1747 ImGui::SameLine(0, tabSpacing);
1748 }
1749
1750 // 2. Right Controls: Toolbar Studio Demo Launcher & Ribbon Display Mode Controls
1751 ImGui::SameLine(width - 195.0f);
1752 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));
1753 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, ImVec4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.16f));
1754 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonActive, ImVec4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.28f));
1755 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, showDemoOverlay ? theme.colorHeaderText : theme.colorHeaderTextMuted);
1756 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontRegular);
1757 if (ImGui::Button("Editor [F6]", ImVec2(90, 48))) {
1758 showDemoOverlay = !showDemoOverlay;
1759 }
1760 if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) {
1761 ImGui::SetTooltip("Open Ribbon Customizer & Layout Editor (F6)");
1762 }
1763 ImGui::PopFont();
1764 ImGui::SameLine(0, 4.0f);
1765
1766 // Display Mode Toggle Icon & Action
1767 const char* modeIcon = "^";
1768 const char* modeTooltip = "Full Ribbon (Click to collapse, right-click for modes)";
1769 if (displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode::MiniToolbar) {
1770 modeIcon = "=";
1771 modeTooltip = "Mini Toolbar (Click to collapse, right-click for modes)";
1772 } else if (displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode::Collapsed) {
1773 modeIcon = "v";
1774 modeTooltip = "Collapsed (Click to expand, right-click for modes)";
1775 }
1776
1777 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontRibbonLarge);
1778 bool modeClicked = ImGui::Button(modeIcon, ImVec2(44, 48));
1779 bool modeRightClicked = ImGui::IsItemClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Right);
1780 if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) {
1781 ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", modeTooltip);
1782 }
1783 ImGui::PopFont();
1784
1785 ImGui::SameLine(0, 2.0f);
1786 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontRegular);
1787 bool chevronClicked = ImGui::Button("...", ImVec2(34, 48));
1788 if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) {
1789 ImGui::SetTooltip("Ribbon Display Modes (Full, Mini, Collapsed, Fullscreen)");
1790 }
1791 ImGui::PopFont();
1792 ImGui::PopStyleColor(4);
1793
1794 if (modeClicked) {
1795 ToggleCollapse();
1796 }
1797 if (modeRightClicked || chevronClicked) {
1798 ImGui::OpenPopup("##RibbonDisplayModePopup");
1799 }
1800
1801 if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##RibbonDisplayModePopup")) {
1802 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontBold ? FolioTheme::FontBold : FolioTheme::FontRegular);
1803 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Ribbon Display Modes");
1804 ImGui::PopFont();

1807 if (ImGui::MenuItem("Full Ribbon", "154px", displayMode == RibbonDisplayMode::FullRibbon)) {
1808 SetDisplayMode(RibbonDisplayMode::FullRibbon);

1823 // 3. Lower Shelf Subsections Built Using Toolbar Machine
1824 if (displayMode != RibbonDisplayMode::Collapsed && animatedHeight > 58.5f && outViewMode == AppViewMode::CanvasWorkspace) {

1864 void RenderShelfContents(float width, float shelfH, bool isMini, CanvasEngine& canvas, InputStateMachine& inputSM, const ThemeManager& theme) {
1865
1866 // HORIZONTAL SUBSECTION SCROLLING VIA MOUSE WHEEL:
1867 // When hovering the ribbon shelf, vertical or horizontal mouse wheel smoothly scrolls subsections!
1868 if (ImGui::IsWindowHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_RootAndChildWindows)) {
1869 float wheel = ImGui::GetIO().MouseWheel != 0.0f ? ImGui::GetIO().MouseWheel : ImGui::GetIO().MouseWheelH;
1870 if (wheel != 0.0f) {
1871 float targetScrollX = ImGui::GetScrollX() - (wheel * 48.0f);
1872 ImGui::SetScrollX(targetScrollX);
1873 }
1874 }
1875
1876 // Smooth tab fade transition
1877 float shelfAlpha = std::clamp(tabTransitionTimer, 0.0f, 1.0f);
1878 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_Alpha, shelfAlpha);
1879
1880 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontRibbonSection ? FolioTheme::FontRibbonSection : FolioTheme::FontRegular);
1881 ImGui::SetCursorPos(ImVec2(16.0f, isMini ? 3.0f : 8.0f));
1882
1883 // Cached SVGs

2336 sec.AddSplitButton("btn_insert_table", iconTable, "Table", "Insert a table grid onto the page", false,
2337 [&]() {},
2338 [&](FolioUI::FlyoutMenuBuilder& menu) {
2339 menu.AddCustom([&]() {
2340 ImGui::Text("Insert Table: %d x %d", s_hoverTableCols, s_hoverTableRows);
2341 ImGui::Spacing();
2342
2343 // Interactive 8x8 Grid Hover Matrix
2344 ImDrawList* gDl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
2345 ImVec2 startPos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
2346 const float cellSize = 18.0f;
2347 const float cellGap = 3.0f;
2348 const int maxC = 8;
2349 const int maxR = 8;
2350
2351 ImVec2 totalGridSz(maxC * (cellSize + cellGap), maxR * (cellSize + cellGap));
2352 ImGui::InvisibleButton("##table_grid_matrix", totalGridSz);
2353 bool gridHovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
2354 ImVec2 mPos = ImGui::GetMousePos();
2355
2356 if (gridHovered) {
2357 int col = static_cast<int>((mPos.x - startPos.x) / (cellSize + cellGap)) + 1;
2358 int row = static_cast<int>((mPos.y - startPos.y) / (cellSize + cellGap)) + 1;
2359 s_hoverTableCols = std::clamp(col, 1, maxC);
2360 s_hoverTableRows = std::clamp(row, 1, maxR);
2361 if (ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left)) {
2362 ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
2363 }
2364 }
2365
2366 for (int r = 1; r <= maxR; ++r) {
2367 for (int c = 1; c <= maxC; ++c) {
2368 float cx = startPos.x + (c - 1) * (cellSize + cellGap);
2369 float cy = startPos.y + (r - 1) * (cellSize + cellGap);
2370 bool isHighlighted = (c <= s_hoverTableCols && r <= s_hoverTableRows);
2371 ImU32 cellBg = isHighlighted
2372 ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorPrimary)
2373 : ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover);
2374 ImU32 cellBorder = isHighlighted
2375 ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorPrimary)
2376 : ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder);
2377 gDl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(cx, cy), ImVec2(cx + cellSize, cy + cellSize), cellBg, 2.0f);
2378 gDl->AddRect(ImVec2(cx, cy), ImVec2(cx + cellSize, cy + cellSize), cellBorder, 2.0f);
2379 }
2380 }

3273 // -------------------------------------------------------------
3274 // SECTION 4: Input Mode (Touch Inking toggle)
3275 // -------------------------------------------------------------
3276 // "Inking" button toggles whether a single finger draws or navigates.
3277 // A custom widget draws a modern green-filled circle indicator badge
3278 // in the button's icon area so the user can tell at a glance whether
3279 // touch-inking is on, separate from the button highlight tint.
3280 //
3281 // When activated, the last active pen preset is also restored so the
3282 // pen carousel immediately highlights the tool that will be used.
3283 //
3284 // NOTE: Pan lives in the Selection section alongside Select/Lasso.
3285 // -------------------------------------------------------------
3286 if (SettingsManager::Instance().IsSectionVisible("sec_input")) {
3287 FolioUI::ToolbarSectionBuilder sec("grp_draw_input", "Input", theme, isMini);
3288
3289 // Reflects the ACTIVE device's tool — not just touch.
3290 // Green whenever the current device (mouse/stylus/touch) is inking.
3291 bool activeDeviceIsInking = (inputSM.GetActiveDeviceTool() == InteractionState::Inking);
3292
3293 // Custom widget: Inking toggle button with green circle badge
3294 sec.AddWidget([&]() {
3295 ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
3296 ImVec2 startPos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
3297 const float btnW = 62.0f;
3298 const float btnH = isMini ? 30.0f : 58.0f;
3299
3300 // Invisible interaction zone
3301 bool clicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##inking_touch_btn", ImVec2(btnW, btnH));
3302 bool hovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
3303 bool pressed = ImGui::IsItemActive();
3304
3305 // Background fill
3306 ImU32 bgFill = activeDeviceIsInking
3307 ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelected)
3308 : (pressed ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemSelected)
3309 : (hovered ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover)
3310 : IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 0)));
3311 if (bgFill != IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 0)) {
3312 dl->AddRectFilled(startPos,
3313 ImVec2(startPos.x + btnW, startPos.y + btnH),
3314 bgFill, 6.0f);
3315 }
3316
3317 // Circle indicator — green filled when active, outlined when inactive
3318 ImVec2 circleCenter(startPos.x + btnW * 0.5f,
3319 startPos.y + (isMini ? btnH * 0.5f : btnH * 0.38f));
3320 const float circleR = isMini ? 6.0f : 10.0f;
3321
3322 if (activeDeviceIsInking) {
3323 // Glowing green filled circle
3324 dl->AddCircleFilled(circleCenter, circleR + 2.5f,
3325 IM_COL32(50, 210, 110, 55)); // soft outer glow
3326 dl->AddCircleFilled(circleCenter, circleR,
3327 IM_COL32(55, 210, 115, 255)); // solid green fill
3328 dl->AddCircle(circleCenter, circleR,
3329 IM_COL32(180, 255, 200, 120), 0, 1.2f); // rim highlight
3330 } else {
3331 // Muted outlined circle
3332 dl->AddCircle(circleCenter, circleR,
3333 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorTextMuted), 0, 1.5f);
3334 }
3335
3336 // Label "Inking" centred at bottom
3337 if (!isMini) {
3338 const char* label = "Inking";
3339 float textW = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label).x;
3340 ImVec2 textPos(startPos.x + (btnW - textW) * 0.5f,
3341 startPos.y + btnH - 16.0f);
3342 dl->AddText(textPos,
3343 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorText), label);
3344 }
3345
3346 // Tooltip
3347 if (hovered && ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayShort)) {
3348 ImGui::BeginTooltip();
3349 if (activeDeviceIsInking) {
3350 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Inking: Active. Click to switch to Pan/Navigate mode.");
3351 } else {
3352 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Inking: Click to switch to drawing mode with the active pen.");
3353 }
3354 ImGui::EndTooltip();
3355 }
3356
3357 // Toggle on click — targets the ACTIVE device, not hard-coded to Touch
3358 if (clicked) {
3359 InteractionState next = activeDeviceIsInking
3360 ? InteractionState::Panning
3361 : InteractionState::Inking;
3362 inputSM.SetToolForDevice(inputSM.ActiveDevice, next);
3363
3364 // Sync the drawWithTouch convenience flag only when touch is active
3365 if (inputSM.ActiveDevice == DeviceType::Touch) {
3366 drawWithTouch = (next == InteractionState::Inking);
3367 SettingsManager::Instance().drawWithTouch = drawWithTouch;
3368 SettingsManager::Instance().Save();
3369 }
3370
3371 // Restore the last active pen preset so the pen carousel
3372 // immediately highlights the tool that will be drawn with.
3373 if (next == InteractionState::Inking) {
3374 auto* p = presetManager.GetActivePreset();
3375 if (p) presetManager.ApplyPreset(*p, activePen);
3376 }
3377 }
3378
3379 // Advance the section cursor past the custom widget
3380 ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(startPos.x + btnW, startPos.y));
3381 }, 6.0f);
3382
3383 sec.Render();

4287 // ============================================================
4288 // ADVANCED DOCUMENT OPTIONS PANEL
4289 // Slides in from the right, covers canvas & sidebar, sits under ribbon.
4290 // Call this after all other ImGui windows in the frame loop.
4291 // ============================================================
4292 void RenderAdvancedOptionsPanel(float screenW, float screenH, float ribbonTopY, float ribbonH,
4293 CanvasEngine& canvas, const ThemeManager& theme) {
4294 if (!advancedOptionsOpen) {
4295 advPanelAnimX = std::max(0.0f, advPanelAnimX - ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime * 8.0f);
4296 } else {
4297 advPanelAnimX = std::min(1.0f, advPanelAnimX + ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime * 8.0f);
4298 }
4299
4300 if (advPanelAnimX < 0.005f) return; // Fully hidden: skip rendering
4301
4302 float panelW = screenW * 0.33f;
4303 float panelH = screenH - (ribbonTopY + ribbonH);
4304 float panelY = ribbonTopY + ribbonH;
4305 float slideOffset = panelW * (1.0f - advPanelAnimX);
4306 float panelX = screenW - panelW + slideOffset;
4307
4308 // --- Dim scrim covering left portion ---
4309 if (advancedOptionsOpen && advPanelAnimX > 0.01f) {
4310 ImDrawList* bgDrawList = ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
4311 ImVec2 scrimMin(0.0f, panelY);
4312 ImVec2 scrimMax(panelX, panelY + panelH);
4313 ImU32 scrimColor = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.28f * advPanelAnimX));
4314 bgDrawList->AddRectFilled(scrimMin, scrimMax, scrimColor);
4315
4316 // Dismiss when user clicks outside the panel
4317 ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
4318 if (ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left)) {
4319 ImVec2 mousePos = io.MousePos;
4320 if (mousePos.y >= panelY && mousePos.x < panelX) {
4321 advancedOptionsOpen = false;
4322 }
4323 }
4324 }
4325
4326 // --- Side Panel ---
4327 ImGuiWindowFlags panelFlags = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize |
4328 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings;
4329
4330 ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(panelX, panelY));
4331 ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(panelW, panelH));
4332 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, theme.colorPanel);
4333 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, theme.colorBorder);
4334 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(18.0f, 14.0f));
4335 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 1.0f);
4336 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 0.0f);
4337 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ScrollbarSize, 6.0f);
4338
4339 ImGui::Begin("##AdvDocOptionsPanel", nullptr, panelFlags);
4340
4341 // Panel title row
4342 ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
4343 ImVec2 wPos = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
4344 // Left edge accent bar
4345 dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(wPos.x, wPos.y), ImVec2(wPos.x + 3.0f, wPos.y + panelH),
4346 IM_COL32(80, 130, 220, 200));
4347
4348 ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, 2));
4349 ImGui::PushFont(FolioTheme::FontRibbonBoldLarge ? FolioTheme::FontRibbonBoldLarge : FolioTheme::FontBold);
4350 ImGui::TextUnformatted("Advanced Document Options");
4351 ImGui::PopFont();
4352
4353 // Dismiss X button top-right
4354 float closeX = panelX + panelW - 36.0f;
4355 float closeY = panelY + 10.0f;
4356 ImGui::SameLine(panelW - 38.0f);
4357 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImVec4(0,0,0,0));
4358 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, theme.colorItemHover);
4359 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonActive, theme.colorItemSelected);
4360 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorTextMuted);
4361 if (ImGui::Button("X##adv_close", ImVec2(28, 28))) {
4362 advancedOptionsOpen = false;
4363 }
4364 ImGui::PopStyleColor(4);
4365 ImGui::Separator();
4366 ImGui::Spacing();
4367
4368 // Helper macro for section headers
4369 auto SectionHeader = [&](const char* label) -> bool {
4370 ImGui::Spacing();
4371 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Header, theme.colorItemSelected);
4372 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered, theme.colorItemHover);
4373 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_HeaderActive, theme.colorItemSelected);
4374 bool open = ImGui::CollapsingHeader(label, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen);
4375 ImGui::PopStyleColor(3);
4376 return open;
4377 };
4378
4379 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorItemText);
4380
4381 // Keep local invert state synced with canvas
4382 isCanvasInverted = canvas.inkColorInverted;
4383
4384 // ── SECTION 1: Canvas View ─────────────────────────────────────
4385 if (SectionHeader(" Canvas View")) {
4386 ImGui::Indent(8.0f);
4387
4388 bool invCanvas = isCanvasInverted;
4389 if (ImGui::Checkbox("Invert Canvas Mode", &invCanvas)) {
4390 isCanvasInverted = invCanvas;
4391 canvas.SetInkColorInverted(isCanvasInverted);
4392 }
4393 ImGui::SameLine();
4394 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorTextMuted);
4395 ImGui::TextUnformatted("(Dark canvas + inverted ink)");
4396 ImGui::PopStyleColor();
4397
4398 ImGui::Spacing();
4399 ImGui::Text("Current Zoom: %.0f%%", canvas.transform.zoom * 100.0);
4400
4401 ImGui::Unindent(8.0f);
4402 }
4403
4404 // ── SECTION 2: Calibrate Canvas to Real World Scale ────────────
4405 if (SectionHeader(" Calibrate Canvas (Real World Scale)")) {
4406 ImGui::Indent(8.0f);
4407
4408 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme.colorTextMuted);
4409 ImGui::TextWrapped("Hold a physical millimeter ruler against your screen. Adjust the DPI slider until the on-screen markings match your real ruler. This guarantees 1:1 true physical scale for drafting and 1:1 export.");
4410 ImGui::PopStyleColor();
4411 ImGui::Spacing();
4412
4413 // Active calibration metrics
4414 float currentDpi = static_cast<float>(canvas.transform.pixelsPerMm * 25.4);
4415 float pxPerMm = static_cast<float>(canvas.transform.pixelsPerMm);
4416 float rulerMmTotal = 50.0f;
4417 float rulerWidthPx = rulerMmTotal * pxPerMm;
4418
4419 ImVec2 rPos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
4420 float rH = 34.0f;
4421 ImDrawList* rDl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
4422
4423 // On-screen calibration ruler (0 to 50 mm)
4424 rDl->AddRectFilled(rPos, ImVec2(rPos.x + rulerWidthPx, rPos.y + rH),
4425 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorItemHover), 4.0f);
4426 rDl->AddRect(rPos, ImVec2(rPos.x + rulerWidthPx, rPos.y + rH),
4427 ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorBorder), 4.0f, 0, 1.0f);
4428
4429 ImU32 tickCol = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorText);
4430 ImU32 numCol = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(theme.colorTextMuted);
4431
4432 for (int mm = 0; mm <= 50; mm++) {
4433 float tickX = rPos.x + mm * pxPerMm;
4434 float tickH = 6.0f;
4435 if (mm % 10 == 0) {
4436 tickH = 14.0f;
4437 char mmStr[8];
4438 snprintf(mmStr, sizeof(mmStr), "%d", mm);
4439 rDl->AddText(ImVec2(tickX - 3.0f, rPos.y + 16.0f), numCol, mmStr);
4440 } else if (mm % 5 == 0) {
4441 tickH = 10.0f;
4442 }
4443 rDl->AddLine(ImVec2(tickX, rPos.y), ImVec2(tickX, rPos.y + tickH), tickCol, (mm % 10 == 0) ? 1.5f : 1.0f);
4444 }

5043
5044 void RenderCollapsedPopup(float width, float topOffset, CanvasEngine& canvas, InputStateMachine& inputSM, const ThemeManager& theme, DocumentSession* session = nullptr) {
5045 if (session) currentSession = session;
5046 if (!isCollapsedPopupOpen || displayMode != RibbonDisplayMode::Collapsed) {
5047 return;
5048 }
5049
5050 float popupY = topOffset + animatedHeight + 2.0f;
5051 float popupH = 96.0f; // Full shelf height
5052 float marginX = 8.0f;
5053 float popupX = marginX;
5054 float popupW = width - (2.0f * marginX);
5055 float popupRounding = 12.0f;
5056
5057 // 1. Outside input / canvas dismiss check:
5058 // Any outside input on canvas (drawing, clicking, scrolling) or pressing Escape hides it immediately
5059 ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
5060
5061 if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape)) {
5062 isCollapsedPopupOpen = false;
5063 return;
5064 }
5065
5066 // Hardware digitizer engagement (stylus pen down, touch gesture) immediately dismisses popup
5067 if (inputSM.currentStylusState == StylusState::Engaged ||
5068 inputSM.pen.isDown ||
5069 inputSM.wasMouseDown ||
5070 inputSM.wasTouchDown ||
5071 (inputSM.isCanvasHovered && (io.MouseClicked[0] || io.MouseClicked[1] || io.MouseClicked[2] || io.MouseWheel != 0.0f))) {
5072 isCollapsedPopupOpen = false;
5073 return;
5074 }
5075
5076 // Mouse click or scroll anywhere outside the popup shelf and tabs row dismisses popup immediately
5077 bool anySubmenuOpen = ImGui::IsPopupOpen(nullptr, ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId);
5078 if (!anySubmenuOpen && (io.MouseClicked[0] || io.MouseClicked[1] || io.MouseClicked[2] || io.MouseWheel != 0.0f)) {
5079 ImVec2 mousePos = io.MousePos;
5080 bool insidePopup = (mousePos.x >= popupX && mousePos.x <= (popupX + popupW) &&
5081 mousePos.y >= popupY && mousePos.y <= (popupY + popupH));
5082 bool insideTabs = (mousePos.x >= 0.0f && mousePos.x <= width &&
5083 mousePos.y >= topOffset && mousePos.y < (topOffset + animatedHeight));
5084 if (!insidePopup && !insideTabs) {
5085 isCollapsedPopupOpen = false;
5086 return;
5087 }
5088 }
5089
5090 // 2. Render Floating Overlay Window Directly on Top of Canvas
5091 // Canvas does not move or resize (contentY remains 58px); popup floats above it.
5092 // Pure shelf background (theme.colorShelf) with NO orange background!
5093 // Rounded corners on all edges with smooth border and multi-layer soft drop shadow.
5094 ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(popupX, popupY));
5095 ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(popupW, popupH));
5096 ImGuiWindowFlags popupFlags = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar |
5097 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize |
5098 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove |
5099 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar |
5100 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse |
5101 ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings;
5102
5103 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f));
5104 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 1.0f);
5105 ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, popupRounding);
5106 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, theme.colorBorder);
5107 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, theme.colorShelf);
5108
5109 if (ImGui::Begin("##CollapsedRibbonPopup", &isCollapsedPopupOpen, popupFlags)) {
5110 RenderShelfContents(popupW, popupH, false /* isMini = false */, canvas, inputSM, theme);
5111
5112 // Floating Aesthetics: Multi-layer soft drop shadow with matching corner rounding
5113 ImDrawList* drawList = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
5114 ImVec2 winPos = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
5115 ImVec2 pMin(winPos.x, winPos.y);
5116 ImVec2 pMax(winPos.x + popupW, winPos.y + popupH);
5117
5118 ImU32 shadowCol1 = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.12f));
5119 ImU32 shadowCol2 = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.06f));
5120 ImU32 shadowCol3 = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.02f));
5121
5122 drawList->AddRect(ImVec2(pMin.x - 1.0f, pMin.y - 1.0f), ImVec2(pMax.x + 1.0f, pMax.y + 2.0f), shadowCol1, popupRounding, 0, 1.5f);
5123 drawList->AddRect(ImVec2(pMin.x - 2.0f, pMin.y - 1.0f), ImVec2(pMax.x + 2.0f, pMax.y + 4.0f), shadowCol2, popupRounding, 0, 3.0f);
5124 drawList->AddRect(ImVec2(pMin.x - 4.0f, pMin.y - 1.0f), ImVec2(pMax.x + 4.0f, pMax.y + 7.0f), shadowCol3, popupRounding, 0, 5.0f);
5125 }
5126 ImGui::End();
5127 ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
5128 ImGui::PopStyleVar(3);
5129 }
5130};
